newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real closes flat in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real closes flat in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real closed flat at 1.0306 per greenback on dollar inflows in calm trading on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Dealers said dollars inflows to pay for shares of Rio de Janeiro power utility Cerj, which was privatized last Wednesday, continued today.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a large Monday surplus of $415 million.
The Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0305 per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market in the late afternoon.
Dealers said the market is expecting a drop in the real-dollar mini-band between Tuesday and Wednesday.
The current mini-band was set on Nov 20 between 1.0305 and 1.0355 per dollar.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed steady at 1.0361 per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed unchanged at 1.095 real per greenback.
